messages:
sami: Heads-up — canary showed ~12% CPU p50 increase on host processes after the slab-unifier merge. Trace attached. :eyes:

arjun: saw it too. quick numbers from the canary: p50 +12%, p95 +6%, allocs up ~20k/s. Main hot functions: ingress::parse_frame -> slab_unifier::merge -> proto::unpack

katie: can you paste the perf summary? curious if it's kernel selection or just more work in parsing

arjun: perf top snippet:
```
 22.4%  ingress_service  ingress::parse_frame
 17.1%  ingress_service  slab_unifier::merge
 12.6%  ingress_service  proto::unpack
  8.5%  libc              memcpy
```

devon: HPACK/HTTP2 writev fragmentation looks suspicious. When slab_unifier emits smaller frames we drop below writev threshold and trigger many syscalls. See socket write count increase in metrics. I can repro with a script.

maria: config snippet from canary
```
ingress:
  http2_max_frame_size: 16384
  writev_min_bytes: 32768
  slab_unifier:
    small_emit_threshold: 512
```

arjun: if we bump `writev_min_bytes` down to 4096 it reduces syscall storm because we coalesce earlier. But that trades off latency for tiny responses. My A/B showed 5% CPU improvement, +0.3ms p50.

sami: @devon can you run the socket micro repro and post flamegraphs? Also let's check KV cache churn — I noticed extra lookups around proto::unpack

devon: flamegraph link: https://perf.example/fg/39876 (flame shows many short stacks ending in sendto/writev). Repro script:
```
for i in {1..1000}; do echo -n "X" | nc -N localhost 8080; done
```

arjun: KV cache churn: logs show `kvcache.miss.rate` spike from 2% -> 12% during canary. unpack path creates ephemeral keys because slab_unifier tags frames with transient ids. Fix: avoid tagging on small frames or drop tag creation path.

katie: propose 3-step plan: 1) revert small_emit_threshold to 1024 in canary, 2) lower writev_min_bytes to 4096 for ingress service, 3) hotfix to prevent transient kvcache keys

ingress-bot: deploy canary-39876 started at 3987654335 by @devon

sami: agree. @maria please open release ticket and assign @arjun for kvcache fix, @devon for syscall repro + tweak. We'll roll canary back if metrics don't improve in 15m :shipit:

katie: adding perf traces to the ticket. :thumbsup:
